buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Nothing decisive on freshness, though it tilts slightly to Bronzetti. Monnet has logged 97 games across 4 matches in 14 days, Bronzetti only 66 across 3.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to Monnet on motivation and pressure. Monnet is on the way up (+57 Elo over 90 days) while Bronzetti has been sliding (-77). Monnet's last 10 run 25 pts above the season win rate, while Bronzetti is 24 pts below it. Offsetting that, when it goes the distance, Bronzetti has won 52% of deciding sets over the past year to Monnet's 37%.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: No clear edge on conditions: two factors pull in opposite directions. Monnet has 14 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Bronzetti only 10, so the adjustment period is shorter. Bronzetti is the more proven player on Clay: 57% wins in 12 months against 52% for Monnet.

bottom_line: The model leans Monnet at 55%; agreement across the three signals is 56/100 (mixed signals). The main risk: Bronzetti is stronger in deciding sets (52% vs 37%) and is fresher (66 vs 97 games in 14 days).
